name: Terisiare
description: Terisiare is a large northern continent of Dominaria, the setting of Antiquities, The Dark, Ice Age, Alliances and Coldsnap, later broken into islands.

summary.text: Terisiare is a large northern continent of Dominaria, the setting of Antiquities, The Dark, Ice Age, Alliances and Coldsnap, later broken into islands.

bio.text: The Thran carved out an empire covering two-thirds of Terisiare, and Yawgmoth destroyed it.

citations.text: "Thran Empire", section "Structure and Governance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Terisiare", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Urza and Mishra's Brothers' War, fought with Thran machines, killed millions and stripped the continent of resources.

citations.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nearly all the Fallaji died in the Last Battle, and Urza's Sylex Blast ended the war and began the Ice Age.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Church of Tal then ruled the war-ravaged city-states and sought to eradicate artifice and magic.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Tivadar's Knightly Order restored civilization, ending the Dark Age.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Glaciers created a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland, and the Kjeldorans replaced the old city-states.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Start of the Ice Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The World Spell warmed the continents, flooding Terisiare into the Terisian Isles.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "The Flood Ages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Flooding of Terisiare", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Terisiare is a flooded continent broken into the Terisian archipelago, and recent card text still refers to it as the continent of the Antiquities War.

citations.text: "Terisiare", section "The Flood Ages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Reality Fracture Commander: card flavor text
citations.text: Reality Fracture Commander: card flavor text (Reality Fracture Commander, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ancient artifacts and machines of war of the Thran Empire are discovered on Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Ancient artifacts of the Thran Empire are discovered on the continent of Terisiare

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
timeline.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When their father falls ill, Urza and Mishra are sent to study at Tocasia's archaeological dig.
timeline.quote: he sent them away to his old friend, Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers' rivalry over the halves causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
timeline.quote: the inadvertent death of Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Double-crossings and sneak attacks between the brothers escalate into open war.
timeline.quote: soon resulting in open war

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Fall of Kroog, Urza's avengers are outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Urza's avengers were completely outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
timeline.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scattered Third Path mages seek refuge from the Church of Tal after the falls of Terisia City and Lat-Nam, finding it in the City of Shadows and the Conclave.
timeline.quote: the Third Path was left without a base of operations, its members scattered across Terisiare

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon gets over his grief, shares his library, and becomes important in early magical research on Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Saying goodbye helped Feldon get over his grief and he lived out his days in happiness.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The study of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Flooding of Terisiare breaks the continent into the Terisian archipelago.
timeline.quote: They are an archipelago of large and small islands formed after the Flooding of Terisiare .

citation.text: "Terisian Isles". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The earliest humans overthrow their draconic masters and form a large empire based in Otaria.
timeline.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a large empire based in Otaria .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nearly all the Fallaji are killed in the Last Battle.
timeline.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisia City is destroyed by Mishra.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by Mishra.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the pilgrimage the brothers grow apart, becoming jealous of Tocasia's attention and guarding their secrets.
timeline.quote: They became increasingly jealous of Tocasia’s attention.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tocasia dies, removing the brothers' last restraining influence, and the battle is joined in earnest.
timeline.quote: Shortly thereafter, Tocasia died, ridding the brothers of their final restraining influence.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza allies with Kroog and spreads influence over Yotia while Mishra works the west and Zegon, where Ashnod joins him as a harsh overlord.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Ashnod joined him, but what a different Ashnod she was!

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers' battle becomes an all-consuming war that kills millions and strips Terisiare of resources.
timeline.quote: Millions of people were killed, slaughtered by one another and by the terrible machines of war.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada binds Dakkon to her will and he travels to Terisiare with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Dihada managed to "tag" Dakkon, binding him to her will.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon and the boy travel to Terisiare, where the boy starts the Carthalion legacy.
timeline.quote: the boy started the Carthalion legacy, named after Dakkon's nickname for the boy, "Carth the Lion".

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Bound to Dihada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the fall of the College of Lat-Nam, Drafna and other Third Path survivors found the City of Shadows in hiding from the Church of Tal.
timeline.quote: founded the City of Shadows

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sima meets her future husband Jodah during a search beyond the city.
timeline.quote: This is how Sima , a member of the school, met her future husband Jodah .

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal rules the war-ravaged city-states and seeks to eradicate artifice and magic.
timeline.quote: the Church of Tal sought to eradicate them

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sarpadian dwarves are teleported to Terisiare by the Lady of Otaria after the fall of their empire.
timeline.quote: Later, the Sarpadian dwarves were teleported to Terisiare by the Lady of Otaria after the fall of their empire.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tivadar's Knightly Order, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, restores civilization by throwing back the Goblin Invasions, ending the Dark.
timeline.quote: He and his Knightly Order, aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver , temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare by throwing back the Goblin Invasions with their Crusade.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast ends the Brothers' War and alters Dominaria's climate, beginning the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: That war ended with the Sylex Blast , which was powerful enough to alter the planet's climate

citation.text: "Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl unleashes a horde of undead, forcing old enemies to work together.
timeline.quote: when the necromancer Lim-Dûl unleashed a horde of undead , old enemies were forced to work together or be overwhelmed

citation.text: "Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glaciers create a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland during the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: During the Ice Age, glaciers created a land bridge between Terisiare and the polar continent known as Northland .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The World Spell warms the continents, flooding Terisiare into the Terisian Isles.
timeline.quote: When the World Spell warmed the continents, melting the old glaciers, Terisiare was flooded and broke apart into smaller islands.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Flood Ages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah is captured by the Inquisition, who kill his mentor Voska, and flees to Alsoor.
timeline.quote: First, he is captured by the Inquisition, who killed his mentor Voska .

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah joins the army and survives the Battle of Pitdown by hiding in a Fountain of Youth.
timeline.quote: he has to hide in a Fountain of Youth to avoid being killed by goblin raiders

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Sima; their ship is hit by a storm and Jodah is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man, who leads him to the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: he falls overboard and is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rising oceans bring new lakes and terrors to Terisiare and the Viscerids spawn everywhere.
timeline.quote: The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare.

citation.text: Benthic Explorers (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources is recalled.
timeline.quote: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

citation.text: Ashnod's Cylix (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flooding and storms ravage Dominaria as the Ice Age ends; Soldev is crushed by artifact creatures.
timeline.quote: the city of Soldev is crushed by rampaging artifact creatures

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisiare is reduced to an archipelago when the floods end.
timeline.quote: Terisiare is reduced to an extensive archipelago

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chaeska builds Tresserhorn twenty years after the Ice Age begins.
timeline.quote: Tresserhorn was built by Chaeska , Keeper of Tresserhorn, twenty years after the Ice Age's onset.

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves flee the expanding Thran empire to Argoth.
timeline.quote: The elves of Terisiare fled the expanding empire to the island of Argoth .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth destroys the Thran empire.
timeline.quote: The empire was ultimately destroyed by Yawgmoth , ruler of Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisiare's flooding is revealed to be not all natural.
timeline.quote: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .

citation.text: Viscerid Drone (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise speaks the World Spell, and the tamanoa rise to bring a new morning to Terisiare.
timeline.quote: When Freyalise spoke the World Spell, the tamanoa rose to bring a new morning to Terisiare.

citation.text: Tamanoa (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Thaw meets Terisiare and mountains shed their ice, crushing homes.
timeline.quote: As the Thaw met Terisiare, mountains shed their icy skins, crushing homes and hopes alike.

citation.text: Icefall (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Terisiare enters the Thaw as its icy shell melts and most inhabitants rejoice at the land's rebirth.
timeline.quote: The icy shell that encased the continent is melting away.

citation.text: "Coldsnap", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A secretive society of mages seeks to use the time of change to shroud the continent in its icy magic.
timeline.quote: a secretive society of mages poised to shroud the continent with their icy brand of magic

citation.text: "Coldsnap", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
timeline.quote: Heidar allied with the undead Order of Stromgald and their leader Haakon

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The Rise of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yavimayan shamans destroy the Phyrexians; Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
timeline.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The End of Rimewind". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rising oceans bring new lakes and terrors to Terisiare, where the Explorers find ancient enemies spawning.
timeline.quote: The rising oceans brought new lakes

citation.text: Benthic Explorers (Masters Edition III, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aevar Borg, guiding a wizard-looking client paid in Soldevi coins, treks toward Ronom Glacier.
timeline.quote: One client, a wizard judging by his garb and his rune-scarred fingertips, who had paid in Soldevi coins, in advance.

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The client". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dagsson recounts watching Phyrexian machines swallow Soldev and reveals Heidar's plan to awaken more from the glacier, and the guide realizes who he is.
timeline.quote: And now a madman, Heidar of Rimewind , wants to build an army of these constructs.

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The master machinist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The guide recognizes his client as the master machinist Arcum Dagsson, on a mission of revenge and guilt.
timeline.quote: “You’re Dagsson. Arcum Dagsson . Aren’t you?”

citation.text: "The Horror at Ronom Glacier", section "The master machinist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Thran migrate from the east and carve out an empire covering two-thirds of Terisiare.
timeline.quote: The Thran came from the east and carved out an empire that covered two-thirds of Terisiare

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Structure and Governance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir and the blind boy Pik catch up with Guldark's Torgash band and Vannemir surveys their encampment.
timeline.quote: they had finally caught up with Guldark and his band of Torgash butchers

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Introduction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pik explains the Graks killed his father and blinded him two years ago.
timeline.quote: They are the ones that killed my pa two years ago and put my eyes out.

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Introduction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vannemir is cut down by an orc axe while defending his village from the Torgash raiders.
timeline.quote: Cut down by an orcish axe while he stood defending his village from their raiders

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the valkyrie Ysidra appears to the dying Vannemir and carries him to her domain.
timeline.quote: Vannemir, son of Valharad

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir sees orc warlords and Heidar's army destroying settlement after settlement across Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Settlement after settlement was extirpated from the face of Terisiare

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir sees Heidar made ruler of Terisiare and the land plunged into endless winter.
timeline.quote: Then he saw Heidar lifted up as ruler of Terisiare and all bowed to his terrible power

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir wakes in a snowy forest where the elf Taaveti finds him.
timeline.quote: Vannemir came to in a forest of evergreens covered in snow and ice

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Meeting Taaveeti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti introduces himself and says Ysidra gave him the sword to give to Vannemir.
timeline.quote: Ysidra gave me the sword to give to you

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Meeting Taaveeti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti explains Vannemir must rescue a prisoner on whom Terisiare's fate hangs.
timeline.quote: He was to rescue the prisoner at all costs

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Meeting Taaveeti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti warns that a fylgja is bound to the Runeblade and may try to take over Vannemir's soul.
timeline.quote: there is a Fylgja bound to it

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Meeting Taaveeti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti leads Vannemir to the Torgash trail at a ruined settlement.
timeline.quote: Taaveti had brought them to the trail

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Pik". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti and Vannemir find the blind boy Pik hidden under the floor of a burned hovel.
timeline.quote: They both cleared the debris away and hauled open the door that revealed a small boy of about twelve

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Pik". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taaveti leaves Pik in Vannemir's care and departs for the woods of Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: My duty is done here, round-ear, and now I am bound for the woods of Yavimaya

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "Pik". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir and Pik track the orcs for several days and find the warlord's camp.
timeline.quote: Eventually, at the mouth of a cavern, they find him.

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The fylgja". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vannemir leads the rescued girls back to Pik, who is reunited with his sister.
timeline.quote: Vannemir found the girls huddled in the forest and he led them back to where Pik was waiting anxiously

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The fate of Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Third Path scatters across the lands after the fall.
timeline.quote: After Terisia's fall, the members of the Third Path scattered across the lands.

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Sylex Blast and the rise of the Church of Tal, remaining members go underground.
timeline.quote: forcing any remaining members of the Third Path to go underground

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Many centuries later, an old man tells his grandchildren the story of the tyrant and the ghost during the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: The Ice Age was upon Dominaria

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and his brother is dead, and sends Tawnos west to teach.
timeline.quote: Tell them what happened here. Tell them what we did, and what we failed to do.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
timeline.quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The war ends with no winner.
timeline.quote: In the end, the war had no winner.

citation.text: Terisiare's Devastation (The Brothers' War Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sylex blast razes the land and leaves Urza alone in the silence.
timeline.quote: Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.

citation.text: Calamity's Wake (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War the tribes are united under the Suwwardi and later ruled by Mishra; Fallaji infantry fight at Kroog and Terisia City.
timeline.quote: During the Brothers' War the tribes were united at last under the Suwwardi tribe

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nearly all Fallaji die in the Last Battle and the empire collapses; Tomakul and Zegon are ruined.
timeline.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle, and the empire collapsed after the war.

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Argive joins with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms, with Urza as Lord High Protector.
timeline.quote: Argive joined with Korlis in 36 AR to form the Combined Kingdoms

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fall of Penregon in 79 AR ends the nation of Argive.
timeline.quote: The Fall of Penregon in 79 AR marked the end of the nation

citation.text: "Argive", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 2500 AR Balduvia declares war on Kjeldor over ancestral lands, beginning a 400-year period of strife.
timeline.quote: Balduvia declared war on Kjeldor over their ancestral lands, starting a 400-year-long period of strife between the two nations

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Facing Lim-Dûl's undead hordes, the traditional enemies ally.
timeline.quote: the two traditional enemy lands allied to battle against his undead hordes

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the World Spell and Thaw, Balduvia's lands become farmable; Balduvians and Kjeldorans form New Argive.
timeline.quote: Together they formed the nation of New Argive

citation.text: "Balduvia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon and the boy leave for Terisiare, where the boy becomes ancestor of House Carthalion.
timeline.quote: Dakkon and the boy left for Terisiare

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal rises to dominance and its zealots wage crusades to eradicate arcane practice.
timeline.quote: Talite zealots waged crusades to eradicate lingering remnants of arcane practice

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Clandestine circles of mages secretly preserve fragments of knowledge.
timeline.quote: clandestine circles of mages continued their studies in secrecy

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisiare fractures into competing tribes, city-states and faiths locked in cycles of betrayal and conquest.
timeline.quote: The people of Terisiare fractured into competing tribes, city-states, and faiths

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Survivors take the inventory and Jaya guides them far east; Jodah lets his name fade into myth.
timeline.quote: let Jaya guide them far east, off the continent of Terisiare
